title: Concurrent MSBuild processes cause intermittent WiX cabinet failures
symptoms: WIXBUILD error 0x80070002: failed to compress cabinet
WixNativeException: wixnative.exe failed ... file not found, though the file exists
Re-running the identical build later succeeds (strong tell)
explanation: Reused MSBuild worker nodes (nodeReuse) plus overlapping builds (CLI + IDE) race on the same obj/ and staging directories. Not a .wxs bug. Fix: close other builds of the same project, `dotnet build-server shutdown`, kill leftover dotnet/MSBuild/wixnative processes, delete obj/bin, run ONE build.
diagnosis: If the same build passes after simply waiting/retrying with nothing changed, it's this race, not your code.
